svg.aria-label: kazi — Web pages and PDFs in, clean Markdown out. A small, personal Firecrawl-like tool: scrape, map and crawl sites into Markdown, read PDFs page by page, extract JSON to a schema with Claude and search the web from the terminal; scrape, map and extract also run in a token-guarded web UI.
